description: AI research and product company behind ChatGPT and the GPT model family, led by CEO Sam Altman. SoftBank completed the third and final $10B tranche of its $30B follow-on commitment on Oct 1, 2026, taking cumulative SoftBank funding to roughly $64.6B and its stake to about 13%.

Global alternative asset manager focused on digital infrastructure — data centers, cell towers, fiber — led by CEO Marc Ganzi, with over $108B AUM. SoftBank completed a $3.1B acquisition of DigitalBridge on Sept 30, 2026, taking it private to help finance AI infrastructure; DigitalBridge keeps operating under Ganzi.

Brookfield Asset Management's AI-focused infrastructure fund, launched Nov 2025 and targeting $10B in equity commitments (up to $100B with leverage/co-investment) for AI data centers, power and compute. NVIDIA and the Kuwait Investment Authority are cornerstone investors; NVIDIA's $2B commitment was disclosed Sept 17, 2026.

NextEra Energy, the Florida-based US utility, is restarting the Duane Arnold Energy Center, Iowa's only nuclear plant (615MW, shut since 2020), backed by a 25-year Google power-purchase agreement. The US Department of Energy closed a $1.9B federal loan on Sept 8, 2026 to finance the restart, targeted for 2029.

UK-based 'neocloud' — a full-stack AI cloud platform building GPU data-center capacity for hyperscalers and AI labs. Ahead of a planned NYSE IPO it raised $3.36B in pre-IPO convertible notes led by Third Point, including NVIDIA's $1B tranche and Mubadala's Abu Dhabi Investment Council, Apollo and Citadel.

Quantum-computing company (Honeywell / Cambridge Quantum lineage) building trapped-ion quantum computers, now public (ticker QNT) after a 2026 IPO. On Sept 8, 2026 it finalized a $100M CHIPS Act award from the US Dept of Commerce for quantum-semiconductor R&D with GlobalFoundries and Monarch Quantum, issuing the government ~2.37M shares.

New York AI startup (founded 2023 by Tarek Alaruri) automating B2B accounts-receivable work — outreach, collections, disputes, cash application. A Sept 2026 Form D disclosed $67.6M in equity sold to 11 investors, alongside an investment and marketplace agreement from Microsoft's venture arm M12.

target: RHAELM Holdings / JERA / Dell Technologies AI data center project (Chiba, Japan)
description: Proposed ~$15B, 400MW AI data center at JERA's Chiba thermal power site near Tokyo, drawing power behind-the-meter from JERA's gas plant. UK developer RHAELM Holdings, JERA (Japan's largest power generator) and Dell Technologies signed an MoU (Oct 2026); Apollo Global Management is slated as RHAELM's financing partner, phased operations targeted 2028-29.

Redwood City defense-biotech startup (founded by Thiel Fellow Jake Adler) building Argus, an air-sampling genomic sensor for real-time pathogen/biothreat detection, already deployed under a CDC biosurveillance agreement. Raised $25M seed at a $150M valuation (Sept 2026), led by Buckley Ventures, with backers including Peter Thiel and Dylan Field.

London AI startup (founded 2024 by ex-DeepMind researcher Toby Shevlane and Ben Day) building forecasting models that predict geopolitical, economic and cultural events; its system outperformed humans in the Summer 2026 Metaculus Cup. Raised $25M seed (Sept 2026) led by Radical Ventures, with Microsoft's M12 and Thinking Machines Lab participating.

AI platform for legal teams (contracts, research, agents), building its own post-trained open-weight models. Raised $550M at a $15.5B valuation (Sept 2026), co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed, with Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Coatue and Elad Gil among existing backers; crossed $400M ARR with 3,000+ customers.

Consumer hearing-aid startup founded by Matthew de Jonge, using AI to redesign hearing aids as a consumer product rather than a purely clinical device, with a flagship NYC audiology clinic. Raised $163M (Sept 2026) at a $740M valuation from Founders Fund, Thrive Capital and Valor Equity Partners.

Bulgarian satellite manufacturer building small and ESPA-class spacecraft for space and defense customers, with 103+ satellites already in orbit. Raised $205M (Sept 2026) led by Riot Ventures and Atreides Management, with GV (Alphabet's venture arm), Founders Fund and Lux Capital among backers, to fund US/EU manufacturing scale-up.

target: Crux AI (Blackstone / Alphabet cloud joint venture)
description: AI cloud joint venture between Alphabet's Google and Blackstone, launched May 2026 to rent out Google's TPU chips as cloud compute outside standard Google Cloud; Blackstone put in an initial $5B equity stake. A 10-bank group led by Goldman Sachs arranged a $22B loan (Sept 16, 2026) secured by the TPUs to fund chip purchases.

Proposed publicly traded REIT that alternative asset manager Blue Owl Capital plans to seed with about $6.5B of its own data-center assets, positioning for an eventual IPO as AI-driven data-center demand grows. Structure, timing and size remain under consideration as of the Sept 2026 report; follows similar listings backed by Blackstone and Brookfield.
